steeringAngleDeg.note: Signed16 x0.1 reproduces historical angle; sign/zero require physical annotation. 4-bit checksum unresolved.

steeringTorqueEps.note: Signed12 reproduces historical EPS torque; native units, not proven Nm or driver torque.

brake.note: Byte1 x0.01 reproduces historical normalized value; not brakePressed or pressure calibration.

gas.note: Byte0 x0.01 retained directly. Historical 1.45% residual is explained by truncation; physical scale remains unverified.

gearShifter.note: Historical labels 1=P, 2=R, 4=D; parking R context is consistent with revised recollection. N/physical direction/checksum/counter unconfirmed.

gasPressed.note: Raw byte0 >3 reproduces historical labels; not a calibrated physical pedal threshold. Simultaneous pedal/override semantics unobserved.

brakePressed.note: Bit43 reproduces historical labels independently of brake amount. Driver braking versus automatic braking/hold unconfirmed; checksum/counter are observational candidates.

cruiseState.standstill.note: Bit8 reproduces historical cruise standstill, not equivalent to vehicle standstill. Actual ACC hold semantics and checksum/counter unknown.

leftBlinker.note: Bit37 reproduces historical leftBlinker; no independent annotated lamp check; checksum unknown.

rightBlinker.note: Bit38 reproduces historical rightBlinker; no independent annotated lamp check; checksum unknown.

wheelSpeeds.fl.note: 12-bit candidate x0.0725 km/h fitted to old decoder; physical wheel identity/width/scale unverified.
